title: Failure indicator and bad restrictions
statement: Let $\\phi$ be a disjunctive normal form on the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$, and let $\\rho:[n]\\to\\{\\text{free},\\text{fixed }1,\\text{fixed }-1\\}$ be a coordinate restriction. The coordinate-switching failure indicator at threshold $1$ for the restriction of $\\phi$ equals $1$ if there are two Boolean inputs on which the restricted function takes different values, and equals $0$ otherwise.
